title: REDAR: Reinforcement-Driven Adaptive Regularisation for Class Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Regularisation-based class-incremental learning (CIL) methods control the stability-plasticity trade-off through fixed coefficients tuned offline, independently of the continual learning objective and blind to phase-specific variations in data volume, task difficulty, and class similarity. We argue this is a fundamental mismatch and propose REDAR: Reinforcement-Driven Adaptive Regularisation for Class Incremental Learning, which treats regularisation strength selection as a sequential decision problem. At each incremental phase, a lightweight reinforcement learning (RL) agent observes a compact state of current performance metrics and incoming data statistics, and outputs the distillation coefficients for that phase. To respect CIL's constraint on historical data access, the policy is trained entirely on pseudo-CIL tasks constructed from the initial phase, then deployed on the incremental sequence without further adaptation. translated_title: REDAR：面向类增量学习的强化驱动自适应正则化
translated_abstract: 基于正则化的类增量学习方法通过离线调优的固定系数来控制稳定性-可塑性权衡，这些系数独立于持续学习目标，并且无法感知各阶段在数据量、任务难度和类别相似度上的具体变化。我们认为这是一种根本性的不匹配，因此提出REDAR：面向类增量学习的强化驱动自适应正则化方法，该方法将正则化强度的选择视为一个序列决策问题。在每个增量阶段，一个轻量级的强化学习（RL）智能体观察由当前性能指标和输入数据统计信息组成的紧凑状态，并输出该阶段的蒸馏系数。为了遵守CIL对历史数据访问的限制，该策略完全在由初始阶段构建的伪CIL任务上进行训练，随后部署到增量序列上而无需进一步适应。实验……
tldr: REDAR将类增量学习中的正则化系数选择建模为序列决策问题，利用轻量级强化学习智能体在每个增量阶段根据性能指标和数据统计自适应地输出蒸馏系数，解决了传统固定系数方法无法适应各阶段数据变化且不匹配持续学习目标的根本缺陷。
en_tdlr: REDAR formulates regularisation strength selection in class-incremental learning as a sequential decision problem, using a lightweight RL agent to adaptively output distillation coefficients at each incremental phase based on performance metrics and data statistics, addressing the fundamental mismatch of offline-tuned fixed coefficients in traditional methods.
